q: How much subsidy does PM Surya Ghar give per kW of rooftop solar?
title: PM Surya Ghar subsidy per kW
short: Rs 30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and Rs 18,000 for the third kW, so the most a household gets is Rs 78,000 for 3 kW or more. Special category states get Rs 33,000 and Rs 19,800. Housing societies get Rs 18,000 per kW for common facilities, up to 500 kW.
audience: Households and housing societies planning rooftop solar

ul: First 2 kW: Rs 30,000 per kW (Rs 33,000 in special category states).
Additional capacity up to 1 kW more: Rs 18,000 per kW (Rs 19,800).
Housing societies and RWAs, common facilities including EV charging: Rs 18,000 per kW (Rs 19,800), up to 500 kW at 3 kW per house.
RWA with 100 kW and 20 houses: Rs 18,000 x 60 kW = Rs 10,80,000, since the cap is 3 kW per house.
The subsidy follows the DC capacity of the modules, not the inverter rating.
Modules must meet the domestic content requirement.
A system gets the subsidy only once; a relocated system does not qualify again.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including net metering lines, so grid import, export and solar generation sit in one monthly record with the factor and source shown. Figures are self-declared.
